minors.title: Rules for minors (under 18)
minors.bannerTitle: Under 18? Read this before you help with a job.
minors.bannerBody: Romanian law protects young people who work. Posters must respect these rules too.

short.from15: 15 to 16: only with your parents’ or legal guardian’s agreement, and only for work that suits your age.
short.under18: Under 18: no heavy, harmful or dangerous work, no overtime and no night work.
short.hours: At most 6 hours a day and 30 hours a week.
short.crime: Breaking these rules is a crime: 3 months to 2 years in prison or a fine.

minors.lawTitle: Protection measures and working conditions for minors

help.title: How to use Pocket

getHelp.1: Tap Post a job in the bottom-right corner.
getHelp.2: Answer the short questions: what, when, how much, where.
getHelp.3: When people offer, you can message them. Tap Pick on the one you like.
getHelp.4: When they start, pay the first half. When the job is done, tap Yes, it’s done and pay the second half, by card or in cash.

giveHelp.1: Look at the jobs on Home or on the Map.
giveHelp.2: Tap a job, then Offer to help. You can send the poster a message.
giveHelp.3: If they pick you, you’ll see the address (and their number, if they added one).
giveHelp.4: Tap I’m starting now when you begin (you get the first half of the pay) and Completed at the end (you get the second half). You get 1 point for every 15 minutes, plus 1 point for the job, on the Top board.

help.minorsBody: Read the <link>rules for minors</link> from the Romanian Labour Code before you help with a job.
help.personBody: <link>Contact the Pocket team</link>: call, email or send a message to a representative.
help.textBody: Tap Aa at the top of the screen.
